WEBSITE INFORMATION

Simple. Transparent. Built for learning.

How this website works, what it collects and where to ask for corrections.

Website status

Developed by alumnus Lefa Malatji with school permission. School-specific notices, policies and operational details are published when supplied and approved by the school.

Your information

This website has no admission form, learner account or document-upload feature. The checklist and learning activity run in your browser; their answers are not submitted to the developer or school. The hosting service may process technical access information under its own policies.

Advertising

No advertising, advertising trackers or analytics tools have been added. Any future sponsorship or advertising would require a separate agreement and review before activation.

External links

Links to education departments, OpenStreetMap, Google Maps and the developer’s portfolio take you to other websites. Those services have their own privacy policies.

Content and photographs

The school illustration is original artwork, not a photograph of the campus. No learner photographs, names, results or personal records are published on this website.

Corrections

For website corrections, email lazylefa@gmail.com. Contact the school directly for admissions enquiries.
